items.name: Code review
items.description: Reviews the current change for bugs before a commit: reads the diff, goes through a checklist, reports findings by severity.

items.name: Commit
items.description: Commits the change in the working tree with a message in the repository's own style: only what is staged or named, one concern per commit, hooks never skipped.

items.name: PR description
items.description: Writes a pull request's title and description from the branch's commits and diff: what changes and why, how it was really checked, what to review closely.

items.name: Debug a failing test
items.description: Reproduces a failing or flaky test alone, reads the whole failure, narrows it down and fixes the cause — never by weakening the test.

items.name: Mutation check
items.description: Checks that tests would catch a bug: breaks the changed code one edit at a time, runs the tests, and writes a test for every break that still passes.

items.name: /changelog
items.description: Adds a CHANGELOG.md line under Unreleased for the change in the working tree.

items.name: /commit
items.description: Commits the working tree's change with a message matching the repository's log and commit rules.

items.name: /release-notes
items.description: Drafts release notes since the last tag from CHANGELOG.md, merged PRs and the log: Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed.

items.name: TLS certificate rejected
items.description: Kubernetes role: x509 errors, an expired or missing ingress certificate, cert-manager not Ready.

items.name: Job or CronJob fails
items.description: Kubernetes role: BackoffLimitExceeded, DeadlineExceeded, pods gone after the TTL, a CronJob suspended, skipped behind a hanging run or past its missed starts.

items.name: GitHub
items.description: GitHub's remote MCP server: issues, pull requests, code search. Needs a personal access token.

items.name: Context7
items.description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks. Remote server, works without a key.

items.name: Grafana
items.description: Dashboards, Prometheus, Loki and Tempo queries, alerts and incidents of your Grafana, read-only. Runs with uvx; needs the Grafana URL and a service account token.

items.name: Block force push
items.description: Stops the agent's runCommand from running git push --force or -f; --force-with-lease still goes through.
